readOnlyStorageFix.problem: Explicit Connect from a remembered paused identity could stop without pairing when identity/control storage became read-only; a later successful read cleared the warning from the failed resume write.
readOnlyStorageFix.resolution: Capture the failed durable resume write before reading; fall back to an explicitly approved session-only pairing, keep existing durable pause/grant unchanged, and reject a concurrent pause/late callback.
